substances.evidence_note: Several short randomized trials, heterogeneous products and doses.
substances.research_summary: Ashwagandha extracts show short-term reductions in stress and anxiety scores. Testosterone and sleep claims rest on smaller and less consistent trials.

claims.text: Ashwagandha supplementation reduces stress and anxiety scores in short-term randomized trials.
Effects on testosterone and sleep are inconsistent and based on smaller trials.

substances.evidence_note: Strong biomarker effects, no proven hard-outcome benefit in trials.
substances.research_summary: B vitamins lower homocysteine reliably. Trials that lowered homocysteine did not reduce cardiovascular events, so the marker is a poor stand-in for clinical benefit.

claims.text: B-vitamin supplementation lowers plasma homocysteine.
Lowering homocysteine with B vitamins did not reduce cardiovascular events in randomized trials.

substances.evidence_note: Mostly rat models from one research group; one negative controlled human trial.
substances.research_summary: BPC-157 is a synthetic pentadecapeptide studied for tissue repair. Animal data look broad, but the only controlled human trial (ulcerative colitis) failed and no human pharmacokinetics exist.

claims.text: In rat models, BPC-157 accelerated healing of tendon, ligament, muscle and bone injuries.
In the only controlled human trial (ulcerative colitis), BPC-157 did not improve remission over placebo.
VEGFR2-mediated angiogenesis is shown in cell culture, but human pharmacokinetics are unpublished.

substances.evidence_note: Extensive trial evidence for performance; sleep effects are well established.
substances.research_summary: Caffeine improves endurance, strength and power output at 3-6 mg/kg. It has a 5-6 hour half-life, so afternoon intake costs sleep quality.

claims.text: Caffeine at 3-6 mg/kg improves endurance performance and muscular strength and power.
Caffeine intake in the afternoon and evening impairs sleep quality and duration.

substances.evidence_note: No human study of the no-DAC variant; evidence comes from the DAC version and register entries.
substances.research_summary: CJC-1295 without DAC is a short-acting GHRH analogue. The long half-life attributed to CJC-1295 comes from the DAC anchor, which this variant lacks; no peer-reviewed human trial exists for it.

claims.text: No peer-reviewed human trial exists for CJC-1295 without DAC.
The long half-life of CJC-1295 comes from covalent albumin binding via the DAC anchor, which the no-DAC variant lacks.
A single dose of the DAC version raised GH 2-10x for 6+ days and IGF-1 1.5-3x for 9-11 days.

substances.evidence_note: Large body of randomized trials and a position stand; long-term safety at standard doses.
substances.research_summary: Creatine monohydrate is the best-supported ergogenic supplement. It raises muscle phosphocreatine and improves strength and lean mass gains alongside resistance training.

claims.text: Creatine supplementation increases muscle phosphocreatine and improves strength and hypertrophy with resistance training.
Long-term use at 3-5 g/day is safe in healthy adults in the reviewed literature.

substances.evidence_note: Cell culture and rat models; no controlled human trial for skin outcomes.
substances.research_summary: GHK-Cu is a copper tripeptide studied for skin repair. Fibroblast and wound-chamber models show collagen effects, while intact human skin absorbs almost none of it without penetration enhancement.

claims.text: GHK-Cu increased collagen synthesis in fibroblast cultures with an optimum near 10^-9 M.
No controlled clinical trial of topical GHK-Cu in humans exists.
Ex-vivo human skin absorbed almost no GHK-Cu without microneedle pretreatment.

substances.evidence_note: Receptor selectivity is measured in animals; small human studies and one failed phase-2 trial.
substances.research_summary: Ipamorelin is a selective growth hormone secretagogue. It releases GH through the ghrelin receptor with little ACTH or cortisol effect in pigs, but human data are small and a phase-2 trial missed its endpoint.

claims.text: Ipamorelin releases growth hormone via the ghrelin receptor GHS-R1a.
In pigs, ipamorelin did not significantly raise ACTH or cortisol even above 200 times the GH ED50.
A phase-2 trial in postoperative ileus missed its efficacy endpoint.

substances.evidence_note: Clear evidence in documented deficiency; risky without lab confirmation.
substances.research_summary: Iron works, but only when iron deficiency is present. Alternate-day dosing improves absorption over consecutive-day dosing, and bisglycinate is better tolerated than sulfate.

claims.text: Alternate-day iron dosing improves fractional absorption compared with consecutive days.
Ferrous bisglycinate raises hemoglobin comparably to other oral iron salts with fewer gastrointestinal effects.
Dose and duration determine hemoglobin response; higher doses are not automatically better.

substances.evidence_note: Multiple randomized trials with small effect sizes and heterogeneous formulations.
substances.research_summary: Magnesium supplementation lowers blood pressure modestly and may help sleep quality in older adults. Muscle performance effects are small and inconsistent across trials and salt forms.

claims.text: Oral magnesium lowers systolic and diastolic blood pressure by a small margin.
Magnesium supplementation may improve insomnia measures in older adults.
Effects on muscle strength and power are small and inconsistent.

substances.evidence_note: One large trial for cognition; cardiovascular data is observational and mixed.
substances.research_summary: A daily multivitamin-mineral is a low-dose baseline for people with limited diet variety. Trials support a small cognitive effect in older adults, while long-term cardiovascular benefit remains unproven.

claims.text: Daily multivitamin-mineral use improved memory performance in older adults in a randomized trial.
Cohort data do not show lower cardiovascular risk with multivitamin use.

substances.research_summary: Selank is an anxiolytic peptide registered in Russia as a nasal spray. A small comparison study found effects comparable to medazepam, but independent replication and placebo-controlled trials are missing.

claims.text: A small Russian comparison study (n=62) found selank roughly as effective as medazepam for generalised anxiety, without a placebo arm.
Selank is registered in Russia; independent replication of its clinical effects is missing.
In cell culture, selank shifts expression of GABAergic genes.

claims.text: In rats, semax increases BDNF and trkB expression in the hippocampus.
Semax is registered in Russia for acute ischaemic stroke and is not approved in the EU or US.
Small open-label Russian studies report faster BDNF rise and recovery after stroke.

Wound-healing data often attributed to TB-500 were generated with a different fragment (LKKTETQ).

claims.text: Regular vitamin C does not prevent colds in the general population, but may shorten duration by a small amount.
Vitamin C accumulates in immune cells and supports several immune functions.

substances.research_summary: Vitamin D3 matters most when intake and sun exposure are low. Fracture reduction appears in deficient and older populations, while supplementation in generally replete adults does not prevent cancer or cardiovascular events.

claims.text: Vitamin D plus calcium reduces fracture risk in older adults, with the clearest effect in people with low vitamin D status.
2000 IU/day did not reduce invasive cancer or cardiovascular events in generally healthy adults in the VITAL trial.

substances.research_summary: Menaquinone-7 (MK-7) has randomized evidence for bone density and arterial stiffness markers. Hard clinical outcomes such as fractures have not been tested in large trials.

claims.text: Three years of MK-7 supplementation slowed bone mineral density loss in healthy postmenopausal women.

claims.text: Protein supplementation adds lean mass and strength gains on top of resistance training, with diminishing returns at high baseline intake.

claims.text: Zinc acetate lozenges shorten common-cold duration when started within the first day of symptoms.
High-dose zinc lozenges reduce several cold symptoms in adults.
